LanguageData.ABY_TMD_RiftNeedlerCore.label: Rift Needler Core
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_RiftNeedlerCore.effectSummary: Unleashes three rift needles in rapid succession, cutting down lightly armored enemies and pressing back dense swarms before they can close.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_RiftNeedlerCore.description: A rift-needle lattice bound into a turret heart. It snaps out quick bursts that tear through light targets and slow dense swarms.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_PlasmaLanceCore.label: Plasma Lance Core
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_PlasmaLanceCore.effectSummary: Hurls a slow ultra-plasma lance built for reach, pressure and the patient cracking of heavy armor.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_PlasmaLanceCore.description: A sealed ultra-plasma channel tuned for patient armor breaking. It favors long reach and impact over rate of fire.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_AshChoirRepeaterCore.label: Ash Choir Repeater Core
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_AshChoirRepeaterCore.effectSumma: Rakes the field with five ash-canticle shards, cruel against animals, light enemies and packed abyssal waves.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_AshChoirRepeaterCore.description: A cycling ash-canticle feed for suppressing bodies rather than breaking armor. Its rhythm is cruel, fast and deliberately wasteful.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_ChoirArcEmitter.label: Choir Arc Emitter
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_ChoirArcEmitter.effectSummary: Adds a timed canticle-wave strike that pulses through crowds while the turret’s main weapon keeps its own rhythm.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_ChoirArcEmitter.description: A secondary canticle emitter that answers clusters with a slow Choir pulse, leaving the main weapon free to keep firing.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_CoolingLattice.label: Cooling Lattice
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_CoolingLattice.effectSummary: Bleeds excess heat through a bound lattice, tightening the firing cycle at the cost of higher power draw.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_CoolingLattice.description: A bound heat lattice that pulls waste heat out of the weapon path, forcing a tighter firing cadence at a heavier power cost.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_TargetingSigil.label: Targeting Sigil
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_TargetingSigil.effectSummary: Extends the turret’s sighting geometry and steadies long-range tracking, demanding extra power to hold the sigil active.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_TargetingSigil.description: A targeting sigil that stretches sighting geometry into a colder, steadier line of judgment.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_ResidueCapacitor.label: Residue Capacitor
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_ResidueCapacitor.effectSummary: Stores abyssal charge between shots, modestly extending reach and cadence while drawing more power from the grid.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_ResidueCapacitor.description: A residue-fed charge vessel that steadies the weapon between bursts, improving reach and cadence without becoming a weapon itself.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_SepulcherRailCore.label: Sepulcher Rail Core
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_SepulcherRailCore.effectSummary: Charges twin sepulcher rails before driving a single high-velocity penetrator into armored elites at extreme range.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_SepulcherRailCore.description: Twin sepulcher rails drink power in silence before releasing one long, decisive penetrator against armored elites.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_CinderMortarCore.label: Cinder Mortar Core
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_CinderMortarCore.effectSummary: Throws an arcing cinder shell that bursts into hot ash and compact splash, strong against clustered enemies and static firing lines.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_CinderMortarCore.description: An arcing cinder heart for punishing clusters, entrenched shooters and enemies that mistake distance for safety.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_NullArcDischarger.label: Null-Arc Discharger
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_NullArcDischarger.effectSummary: Releases a charged null-arc pulse that burns shields, stuns machines and chains through clustered elite support.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_NullArcDischarger.description: A null-arc coil that turns stored charge into a punishing pulse against shields, machines and clustered elite support.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_AbyssalHarpoonProjector.label: Abyssal Harpoon Projector
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_AbyssalHarpoonProjector.effectSu: Drives a heavy abyssal harpoon into breach targets, slowing their advance and dragging lesser bodies off their line.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_AbyssalHarpoonProjector.descript: A brutal projector that pins the advance with abyssal harpoons, turning momentum into restraint.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_VesperLanceArray.label: Vesper Lance Array
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_VesperLanceArray.effectSummary: Projects a saint-clean lance with better reach and armor pressure than plasma while firing far faster than a sepulcher rail.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_VesperLanceArray.description: A saint-clean lance array built for deliberate punishment: more precise than plasma, less ponderous than a sepulcher rail.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_RiftFlakBloom.label: Rift Flak Bloom
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_RiftFlakBloom.effectSummary: Launches a compact rift seed that blooms into cutting shards around the impact point, punishing light swarms and clustered raiders.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_RiftFlakBloom.description: A compact rift seed that blossoms into cutting fragments around impact, made to punish bodies packed too closely together.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_SanctifiedPrismEmitter.label: Sanctified Prism Emitter
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_SanctifiedPrismEmitter.effectSum: Fires a charged prism bolt that cuts through a narrow lane, refracting judgment through enemies standing behind the first target.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_SanctifiedPrismEmitter.descripti: A prism emitter that compresses sanctified violence into a narrow line, punishing enemies who stack behind one another.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_CrowncoilGaussMinigun.label: Crowncoil Gauss Minigun
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_CrowncoilGaussMinigun.effectSumm: Builds a six-lane crowncoil phase before pouring out a gauss storm of repeated verdicts against elite bodies and heavy swarms.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_CrowncoilGaussMinigun.descriptio: A crowncoil engine that turns disciplined gauss fire into a storm of repeated verdicts against elite bodies and heavy swarms.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_CrownfireRocketChoir.label: Crownfire Rocket Choir
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_CrownfireRocketChoir.effectSumma: Launches a vertical crownfire carrier that splits into guided micro-rockets over the target zone, saturating swarms and breach packs with sacred fire.
LanguageData.ABY_TMD_CrownfireRocketChoir.description: A crownfire carrier choir that breaks open above the battlefield, scattering guided fire across swarms and breach packs.
